title: spec review: P2 + P3/P4 (library, v3): canonical evidence objects and a deterministic context router (HIDE/SHORT/LONG/FULL) with role profiles, pure functions, no packet wiring
spec:
This task builds the evidence + context-router library; the rules in sections A and B below are the sole source of truth (the program brief is not on the goal branch; do not look for it). This task builds the library; T-<wiring task> (filed separately, depends on this) hooks it into spawn packets in shadow. No existing behaviour changes.

A. orchestrator/evidence.py (new)
- `@dataclass(frozen=True) Evidence`: id (str, 12-hex sha256 over f"{source_type}|{location}|{content_hash}"), source_type (one of SOURCE_TYPES = ("source_chunk", "test_result", "scout_finding", "memory_entry", "graph_finding", "previous_result", "review_finding", "architecture_note", "decision", "external_doc")), location (str: path[:line-range], task id, memory heading), commit (str, goal head sha or ""), content_hash (sha256 of the raw content, full hex), content (str, raw, bounded by the caller), summary_short (str ≤ 160 chars: deterministic first meaningful line / signature / heading), summary_long (str ≤ 600 chars: first 600 chars of content with whitespace collapsed; callers may pass a better one), relevance (dict: scope_match bool, title_terms int (count of task-title words ≥4 chars found in content, case-insensitive), path_terms int (scope path stems found), recent_task str|None), provenance (one of "repo", "bus", "memory", "scout", "external"), observed_at (float epoch), trust ("trusted" for provenance repo/memory, "untrusted" otherwise).
- `make(source_type, location, content, *, commit="", provenance, task=None, scope=(), summary_long=None, observed_at=None) -> Evidence` computes id, hashes, summaries and relevance from task title/scope when task is given.
- `EvidencePool` bound to a goal (NOT `Pool`: orchestrator/pool.py already owns that name): file `.orchestrator/evidence/<goal>.jsonl` under STATE (create dir), `add(ev)` idempotent by id (returns existing), `get(id)`, `by_type(t)`, `fresh(ev, head_sha)` (True when ev.commit == head_sha or source_type not in ("source_chunk","test_result")), `stale_ids(head_sha)`. Never store secrets: run jev.redact over content before persisting and note it in the docstring.
- `cache_key(ev, task_class, role, level)` = sha256 of f"{ev.content_hash}|{task_class}|{role}|{level}"[:16] (P7 key shape; no summariser yet).

B. orchestrator/context_router.py (new)
- LEVELS = ("HIDE", "SHORT", "LONG", "FULL"); `@dataclass Routed`: evidence_id, level, reason (short deterministic string, e.g. "in_scope_file", "acceptance", "failing_output", "unrelated_memory", "stale", "read_scope", "dependency", "ambiguous"), tokens_full, tokens_at_level (chars//4 of the text render() would emit).
- `route(task, candidates: list[Evidence], *, role, head_sha=None, cfg=None) -> RoutedPacket` with RoutedPacket fields: items (list[Routed]), candidate_tokens, routed_tokens, reduction_ratio (routed/candidate, 1.0 when candidate 0), ambiguous_ids (list), profile (role name), rules_version ("v1").
- Deterministic rules (P4), applied in this order, first match wins: FULL when source_type=="source_chunk" and location's path is in task scope (write scope) and role in ("execute", "scout"); FULL for source_type "test_result" whose location matches a failing id in task.constraints/pipeline (fix rounds) or whose content contains "FAIL"/"ERROR"; FULL for the task's own spec/acceptance (source_type "architecture_note" with location "task:<id>:spec|acceptance", callers create these); HIDE when relevance.scope_match is False and title_terms == 0 and path_terms == 0 and source_type in ("memory_entry", "decision", "previous_result", "review_finding"); HIDE when not fresh(ev, head_sha) and source_type in ("source_chunk", "test_result"); SHORT for source_chunk not in scope (read scope / imports) in every role; LONG for previous_result, scout_finding, decision, memory_entry that match by scope or title terms; everything else → LONG with reason "ambiguous" and the id appended to ambiguous_ids (P5 hands these to Jev later; never call Jev here).
- Role profiles (P6): execute as above; review: source_chunk in scope → LONG (interface summary) not FULL, review_finding/previous_result → SHORT, test_result → FULL; security_review: like review plus FULL for any source_chunk whose path matches a [review] security_paths glob from cfg; planner: every source_chunk → SHORT, decisions/architecture_note → LONG; scout: FULL only for source_chunk in scope, else SHORT. Unknown role → execute profile.
- `render(routed_packet, evidence_pool_or_lookup) -> str`: "## evidence (routed v1)" followed by one block per non-HIDE item: SHORT = "- {location} — {summary_short}", LONG = "- {location}\n  {summary_long}", FULL = "- {location}\n```\n{content}\n```"; HIDE items are counted in a trailing line "hidden: N". Deterministic ordering: FULL, LONG, SHORT, then by location.
- `decision_row(task, routed_packet, *, mode)` returns a dict that the caller splats directly: `decision_log.record(**row)`; the dict therefore INCLUDES kind="context_selection" and subject=task["id"] plus candidates = [id:level], hard_constraints = the FULL reasons, deterministic = {counts per level, candidate_tokens, routed_tokens, reduction_ratio, ambiguous: n}, selected = "routed v1", reason = f"{role} profile rules v1", mode = mode; no chain-of-thought text, no content. (Uses decision_log kind context_selection from T-0772.)

C. Tests (unittest, `import _harness` first): tests/test_evidence.py::test_make_ids_are_content_addressed_and_redacted, ::test_pool_add_is_idempotent_and_fresh_by_commit; tests/test_context_router.py::test_execute_profile_full_for_scope_hide_unrelated_memory, ::test_review_profile_long_for_scope_and_full_tests, ::test_render_orders_and_counts_hidden, ::test_reduction_ratio_and_ambiguous_bucket, ::test_decision_row_has_no_content. Fixtures build Evidence via make(); no real repo needed.
D. docs/context-economy/05-context-router.md (≤80 lines): the rule table per role, the Evidence schema, what shadow will log (from the wiring task), what is explicitly not done yet (Jev P5, summariser P7, active mode P21).
Constraints: no new dependencies; never call Jev; never read files outside STATE in this module (callers build Evidence). Do not ask questions; decide and note decisions in the result.

SPEC v2 (2026-09-22 15:45) after spec review T-0784 (request_changes), binding on top of v1:
- The brief citation is dropped; sections A/B are the source of truth. 05-context-router.md documents the rules as implemented and lists Jev classification, query-time summaries and active mode as "not in this task".
- evidence.EvidencePool replaces the name Pool everywhere (class, docs, tests).
- decision_row() returns the full keyword set for decision_log.record (kind, subject, candidates, hard_constraints, deterministic, selected, reason, mode, extra); the test test_decision_row_has_no_content asserts decision_log.record(**row) succeeds against the harness root and the stored row contains no Evidence.content text.
- Acceptance "no change to any existing module" becomes mechanically checkable: `git diff --stat goal/T-0760...HEAD` names only files in this task's scope; the Planner runs that check before merge.

SPEC v3 (2026-09-22 16:00) after spec review T-0788 (request_changes), binding on top of v2; a fourth round is waived per the three-round precedent:
- Rule 2 (FULL test_result for failing ids): failing ids come from task.get("resume_hint", {}).get("failures") parsed exactly like orchestrator/failures.py test_ids / daemon._test_ids (import and reuse failures.test_ids; never re-implement the parser). task.constraints and task.pipeline are NOT consulted. Fallback clause (content contains FAIL/ERROR) stays.
- Scope resolution everywhere in route(): `scope = task.get("scope") or task.get("write_scope") or []`, matching jev_sched.py:81, stale.py:52, speculation.py:62. Path match = exact path or the evidence location's path part (before ':') equals a scope entry.
- evidence.fresh(ev, head_sha) is a MODULE-LEVEL function (no pool or goal state); EvidencePool.fresh delegates to it as a staticmethod. context_router.route() calls evidence.fresh directly and takes no pool parameter.
- Add tests: tests/test_context_router.py::test_failing_ids_come_from_resume_hint (a task with resume_hint.failures naming tests/test_x.py::test_y routes that test_result FULL with reason failing_output) and ::test_write_scope_alias_routes_full (task with write_scope instead of scope).
acceptance: docs/context-economy/05-context-router.md exists; git diff --stat goal/T-0760...HEAD names only files in scope; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0

risks.issue: Spec's blanket constraint 'never call Jev' contradicts section A's explicit instruction to call jev.redact() over content before persisting. jev.py's docstring shows 'Jev' names the external TypeSafe AI HTTP judge (jev.ask(), POST to api.typesafe.ai) — a distinct, unrelated function from jev.redact(), a stdlib-only text sanitizer. An executor reading the constraint literally could skip the redact() call to comply, silently reintroducing the secret-leak risk section A exists to close, or could refuse to import jev at all and block the 'never store secrets' requirement.

Evidence.relevance (scope_match/title_terms/path_terms) is computed once at make() time against whichever task built it, then cached content-addressed in EvidencePool (bound to a goal, not a task). route()'s HIDE rule and the catch-all ambiguous-LONG rule read that precomputed relevance directly rather than recomputing it against the task passed into route() — only the FULL-for-scope rule recomputes scope live from task.scope. Since pooling is meant to let evidence be reused across a goal's sibling tasks, reusing the same content-addressed Evidence for a task with a different title/scope than the one it was made() for will silently misroute it (wrong HIDE or wrong bucket) with no staleness signal. Won't break this task's fixture tests (each presumably builds Evidence matched to its own task) but is a real gap the wiring task will hit.

suggested_spec_changes: Reword the 'never call Jev' constraint to 'never call jev.ask() / the external Jev HTTP API; jev.redact() in evidence.py is required and exempt' so section A's redact() requirement and the blanket constraint can't be read as contradictory.

Clarify whether route()'s HIDE and ambiguous-LONG rules should recompute scope_match/title_terms/path_terms live against the task argument (like the FULL-for-scope rule does) or whether callers are required to always make() fresh Evidence per task before calling route(), so EvidencePool reuse across a goal's tasks doesn't silently misroute on stale relevance.
